non_attribution: No exclusive CPU, AP, PX4, scheduler, or DDS root cause is assigned. The retained records contain no per-thread CPU decomposition for the failing groups.

For 8fmacpgy the 63.993754 ms work-over of the last group overlaps planner child startup (high-water verified 351.290481452 s, node spawned 351.29149844 s, group end 351.423937361 s), but overlap is not causation and the retained records cannot separate child startup from FC, publish, or scheduler delay.

For zzmg3k47 and tpwl1k4p the crossing increment is only 92179 / 44659 ns inside the next group's release wait; nothing in the records identifies which of health call, sleep tail, record write, or scheduler wake supplied it.
Different wall origins are never mixed: no cross-run subtraction of monotonic or wire wall values appears in this report.
extrapolation_limits: bomvjsmg (75321700 ns worst lateness, 23140 groups, guard not crossed, segment closed) is a lighter single-segment release run and must not be extrapolated to the complete two-segment P+V combo.

For zzmg3k47 and tpwl1k4p the recorded group starts never reach the 100 ms limit (max 99999916 / 99994226 ns); a claim of the form 'the run failed because a group started more than 100 ms late' is not supported by the retained records.
For nqyqcagl and 8fmacpgy the latch is an end_group work-over; their maxima must not be merged with the begin_group release-wait mechanism of zzmg3k47/tpwl1k4p.
